description: Canonical UUID syntax for startup-config v1 player and ability-policy ID lists only. Accept exactly lowercase 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal spelling, without restricting version or variant bits. This corpus is not the Dialogue wire UUID contract and does not assert player authentication or profile membership.
